# `aitbc market process`

Process a video using an FFmpeg software offer and pay metered escrow.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market process [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--offer-id-or-plugin-id` | text | — | yes | The Offer id or plugin id. |
| `--input-file` | path | — | yes | The Input file. |
| `--output-container` | text | `mp4` | no | Output container format (e.g. mp4, webm) |
| `--codec` | text | `h264` | no | Target codec (e.g. h264, vp9, av1) |
| `--resolution` | text | `1080p` | no | Target resolution (e.g. 1080p, 720p, 480p) |
| `--bitrate` | text | `5M` | no | Target bitrate (e.g. 5M, 10M) |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market process --offer-id-or-plugin-id <offer_id_or_plugin_id> --input-file <input_file>
aitbc market process --offer-id-or-plugin-id <offer_id_or_plugin_id> --input-file <input_file> --output json
```
